one_sentence_story: When Schachter and Singer injected students with pure adrenaline disguised as a vitamin shot, men warned about shaky hands stayed calm while unwarned men caught either giddy joy or anger from an actor in the room — showing emotion pairs bodily arousal with the story your brain tells about it.
so_what_for_you: Before trusting a sudden wave of anger or dread, check your body's hidden inputs first — caffeine, poor sleep, or stage adrenaline — so you don't pin raw chemistry onto the nearest person.
